code.finding: The 409 predicate was hand-inlined at three separate call sites; extracted to is409() helper here and imported in folder/index.ts and file/index.ts.

Independent resolve + encrypt-upload operations in updateFileMetadata were sequential; parallelised with Promise.all since neither depends on the other's result.
vi.mock('../errors') fully re-implements the module; adding any new export to errors.ts requires adding it to this mock or tests fail with cascading import errors.

Phase 44 intentionally removed the separate batchPublishIpnsRecords call (updateFileMetadata now publishes internally with CAS to avoid double-publish) but shared-write.test.ts line 348 still asserts the removed call — stale test left unfixed pending rebase.

workflow: When a branch is stacked, use git diff origin/<base-branch>...HEAD -- <paths> to isolate only the net changes for review/simplify, never diff against main.

The /simplify skill runs 4 parallel review agents (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) then applies only the safe, behavior-preserving subset; the skip list and rationale should be captured as todos.
Adding a new export to a module that is fully mocked in tests requires updating the mock immediately or all tests that import the mocked module will fail with cascading import errors.

Phase ordering for stacked branches: merge base phase to main first, then rebase the stacked branch to drop stale base-phase copies before PRing — otherwise the stacked PR carries stale code from the base branch.

friction: Promise.all refactor on file/index.ts caused 5 cascading test failures because vi.mock('../errors') in file.test.ts did not include the newly-added is409 export — required a follow-up mock fix before tests were green.
